findings.claim: Exclude document metadata from required banner detection. A missing visible mock or mode banner can currently pass, weakening AC7's preserved T0 protection.
findings.evidence: By inspection, MOCK_PAGE.replace('<title>Terraluna</title>', '<title>Mock bundle — placeholder data, not results</title>').replace(MOCK_P, '') is accepted. The title becomes a banner holder at line 217; bannerParts promotes it to head, whose full text equals the expected warning. Main, footer and mode checks remain satisfied, so pageProblems returns no problems despite there being no visible mock warning. The same substitution works for the shipping-mode banner. Existing missing-banner tests cover script payloads, not document titles. Require banners within the rendered body, exclude metadata from page-text counting, and add both regressions.
